mergedParams.userDescription: Ink bleed water reveal on canvas texture transition effects between videos

output.title: Ink Bleed Water Reveal Canvas Texture Transitions

prompts.prompt: Create an ink bleed transition preset where the outgoing video dissolves into liquid ink that spreads across a canvas texture, revealing the incoming video underneath. The transition should use a 2-second overlap period where the outgoing video applies a custom ink dissolve filter effect (using SVG filters for liquid distortion) while simultaneously fading out. The incoming video starts with a grainy canvas texture overlay that gradually becomes clear as the ink effect completes. Use a BaseLayout container with a canvas texture background image, position both VideoAtoms absolutely with the incoming video at a lower z-index. Apply a turbulence filter to the outgoing video that increases over time to create the ink bleeding effect, combined with opacity fade from 1 to 0. The incoming video should have a multiply blend mode initially that transitions to normal during the overlap.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps className='relative bg-amber-50' and canvas texture background-image. Two VideoAtoms: outgoing with duration matching source minus 2s overlap, incoming starting at outgoing.duration - 2s. Outgoing video uses generic opacity effect from 1 to 0 over last 2s, plus custom filter effect with SVG turbulence increasing from 0 to 0.5. Incoming video has blend-mode multiply transitioning to normal, with opacity 0 to 1 over first 2s. Calculate BaseLayout duration as video1.duration + video2.duration - 2s overlap. Use provider mode effects with targetIds for each video.

prompts.prompt: Design a water reveal transition where the outgoing video appears to be washed away by flowing water ink, revealing the incoming video as if painted onto wet canvas. Implement a 1.5-second overlap where the outgoing video slides diagonally upward while applying a wave distortion effect that makes it appear to ripple like water. The incoming video fades in from below with a wet paint effect using CSS filters (blur + contrast adjustments). Create the water flow using animated clip-path or mask that moves across the screen. Position videos in a BaseLayout with 'overflow-hidden', use transform3d for GPU acceleration on the slide motion, and apply a subtle shake effect during the peak transition moment at 0.75 seconds.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden' classes. Outgoing VideoAtom with transform: translate3d sliding to top-right over 1.5s using generic transform effect. Apply filter blur(0px) to blur(4px) and back to create ripple. Incoming VideoAtom starts with filter: blur(8px) contrast(1.2) transitioning to normal. Add ShapeAtom as animated mask using clip-path polygon animation. Shake effect using transform with small random translations at 0.75s mark. Duration calculation: media1 + media2 - 1.5s. All effects in provider mode targeting specific atom IDs.

prompts.prompt: Build an artistic ink pool transition where videos blend through a central ink pool that expands and contracts. The outgoing video shrinks into a circular ink droplet at the center while rotating slowly, then the ink pool expands outward revealing the incoming video with a radial wipe effect. Use a 2.5-second overlap period with three distinct phases: contraction (0.8s), pool state (0.9s), and expansion (0.8s). Apply heavy color grading during the pool state to simulate ink mixing - desaturate and add blue/black tinting. The incoming video should emerge with a displacement map effect that makes it appear to surface from liquid.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-slate-900' for ink background. Outgoing VideoAtom with scale transform from 1 to 0.2 over 0.8s, rotate 180deg, and border-radius transitioning to 50%. Apply sepia and saturate filters during pool phase. Incoming VideoAtom uses radial-gradient mask expanding from center, starting at scale 0.2 and expanding to 1. Add subtle brightness oscillation during pool state. Use CSS custom properties for coordinating timing across effects. BaseLayout duration = video1 + video2 - 2.5s. Provider mode with staggered effect timing.

prompts.prompt: Create a canvas stroke transition where the outgoing video is progressively painted over with ink brush strokes that reveal the incoming video beneath. Implement using multiple thin rectangular ShapeAtoms that animate across the screen like brush strokes, each with slightly different timing and opacity. The strokes should have a hand-painted quality with varying thickness and opacity. During the 1.8-second overlap, create 12-15 brush strokes that sweep across at different angles. The outgoing video fades out in sections as strokes pass over, while the incoming video is revealed with a soft feathered edge effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout container with z-index layering. Incoming VideoAtom at z-0, outgoing at z-10, brush stroke ShapeAtoms at z-20. Each ShapeAtom has random width (2-8%), height (100%), rotation (-15 to 15deg), and uses transform translateX animation with cubic-bezier easing. Outgoing video uses mask-image with linear gradients that animate to create sectional reveal. Incoming video has initial blur(2px) clearing as strokes complete. Stagger stroke animations by 0.1-0.2s. Total overlap 1.8s, BaseLayout duration = sum of videos - 1.8s.

prompts.prompt: Develop a bleeding edge transition where the edges of the outgoing video appear to bleed ink that flows downward like gravity-affected liquid, pooling at the bottom before the incoming video rises from the ink pool. Use a 3-second dramatic overlap with physics-based animation timing. The ink bleed should start from multiple points along the edges with different flow speeds. Apply chromatic aberration to the bleeding edges for a viscous liquid effect. The incoming video emerges with a surface tension effect - starting distorted and stabilizing as it rises.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative h-full w-full bg-black'. Outgoing VideoAtom with custom clip-path animation creating dripping edges using cubic bezier paths. Apply CSS filter with RGB channel splits for chromatic aberration: translateX on red/blue channels. Multiple absolutely positioned ShapeAtoms for ink drips with gravity-based transform animations (accelerating downward). Incoming VideoAtom starts at translateY(20%) with scale(1.1, 0.9) for squash effect, animating to normal. Use will-change: transform for optimization. 3s overlap, calculate total duration accordingly.

prompts.prompt: Design a splatter reveal transition where ink splatters appear to hit the outgoing video, each splatter revealing portions of the incoming video through expanding circular masks. Create 8-10 splatter points that appear at staggered intervals during a 2.2-second overlap. Each splatter should start as a small circle that rapidly expands with a bounce easing, with ink droplets flying outward. The outgoing video should react to each impact with a localized ripple distortion effect. Add subtle camera shake on each splatter impact for dynamic energy.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with both VideoAtoms absolutely positioned. Create splatter masks using multiple radial-gradient mask-images on the outgoing video, each animating from 0% to 30% radius. Use ShapeAtoms for flying droplets with physics-based trajectories using transform with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Apply SVG filter distortion at splatter points using feTurbulence. Container shake using transform translate with 4px random movement on impact frames. Stagger splatter timing: first at 0s, last at 1.5s, expansion completes by 2.2s. Duration = video1 + video2 - 2.2s.

prompts.prompt: Create a wash transition where the outgoing video appears to be washed with water, causing its ink/colors to run downward in streams, revealing a pristine incoming video underneath. The wash effect should start from the top with water flowing downward, creating vertical streaks of running color. During the 2-second overlap, the outgoing video's saturation increases dramatically before bleeding out, while applying vertical motion blur to simulate running ink. The incoming video should have a wet glossy effect initially that dries to normal appearance.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with gradient background transitioning from transparent to a subtle blue tint. Outgoing VideoAtom with CSS filter: saturate(200%) transitioning to saturate(0%) + blur(0 8px) for vertical blur only. Use mask-image with linear-gradient strips animating downward at different speeds. Incoming VideoAtom with initial filter: contrast(1.3) brightness(1.1) for wet look, normalizing over time. Add multiple thin ShapeAtoms as water streams with opacity gradients. Transform scaleY for drip elongation effect. 2s overlap period, GPU-accelerated transforms throughout.

prompts.prompt: Build an absorption transition where the outgoing video appears to be absorbed into canvas fabric, with ink bleeding through the fibers before the incoming video emerges from the absorbed ink. Use a 2.8-second cinematic overlap with three stages: absorption (1s), diffusion (0.8s), and emergence (1s). During absorption, the outgoing video's edges become fuzzy and colors desaturate while scaling down slightly. The diffusion stage shows ink spreading through fabric texture. The emergence shows the incoming video materializing from the ink stains with increasing clarity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with canvas texture overlay using ::before pseudo-element. Outgoing VideoAtom scales from 1 to 0.95 with blur edges using box-shadow inset. Apply grayscale filter increasing to 80% during absorption. Use noise texture ShapeAtom with mix-blend-mode: multiply for fabric effect. Incoming VideoAtom starts at scale(0.9) with opacity 0, heavy blur(12px), clearing progressively. Add subtle hue-rotate animation during diffusion phase. Complex timing with cubic-bezier easing for organic feel. Total duration = video1 + video2 - 2.8s.

prompts.prompt: Design a capillary action transition where ink appears to spread through paper fibers via capillary action, creating organic branching patterns that reveal the incoming video. The transition should feel like watching ink spread through wet paper under a macro lens. Implement with a 2.4-second overlap using procedurally generated branching paths. The outgoing video should become increasingly transparent along the spreading ink paths, while the incoming video gains definition. Add paper grain texture and subtle color bleeding at the edges of the spreading ink.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with paper texture background image and grain filter. Use multiple clip-path polygons on outgoing VideoAtom creating branching reveal patterns, animated with custom timing functions. Each branch starts from center, spreads outward with decreasing speed. Incoming VideoAtom has inverse clip-paths, starts with blur(6px) and low opacity. Add ShapeAtoms for ink branch visualization with stroke-dasharray animation. Apply color-dodge blend mode at branch edges for bleeding effect. Use CSS custom properties to coordinate branch timing. 2.4s overlap, performance optimized with transform3d.

prompts.prompt: Create a tidal wash transition where waves of ink wash over the outgoing video in multiple passes, each wave revealing more of the incoming video like tidal waters on a beach. Implement 3-4 wave passes during a 3.2-second overlap, with each wave having different intensity and coverage. The outgoing video should distort with each wave pass using displacement effects, while becoming increasingly transparent. The incoming video emerges with a wet sand texture effect that gradually clears. Add foam-like edges to each wave using white noise patterns.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden' containing wave ShapeAtoms. Create waves using SVG paths with animated transform: translateX and scaleY. Outgoing VideoAtom applies filter distortion synchronized with wave passes using feTurbulence. Opacity decreases 25% with each wave. Incoming VideoAtom uses multiple mask-image layers for progressive reveal. Add white ShapeAtoms with noise texture for foam, using opacity fade and scale animation. Wave timing: 0s, 0.8s, 1.6s, 2.4s starts, each lasting 0.8s with overlap. Calculate total as video1 + video2 - 3.2s. GPU acceleration on all transforms.
